title: Taapsee Pannu says she’s never met Kangana Ranaut, addresses their past feud: ‘A reflection of our upbringings’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Taapsee Pannu and Kangana Ranaut had a public feud in 2019 and 2020. Of late, Taapsee spoke about her equation with Kangana and opened up that she has never met the star. She also opened up about the possibility of joining politics.

Adding to this, Taapsee Pannu on feud with Kangana Ranaut. ‘People can decide who comes from where’ Speaking about her feud with Kangana , Taapsee shared that the way they speak about each other is a reflection of their upbringing. She told India Today, “I haven't met her. I didn't meet her before when these so-called issues started. I haven't met her now as well. My opinion on her is reflective of my upbringing and my way of talking, my way of perceiving things and hers... she stands by hers. So, I think that's enough for everybody to look and decide who comes from where."

Meanwhile, Taapsee also spoke about the possibility of entering politics. She shared, “I am too honest and vulnerable for this. Also, I want to do a few more films. I am not at all considering joining and I don't have the DNA for that.” Taapsee also shared that she takes an interest in political issues and is vocal about them as an educated citizen rather than approaching such matters from a political standpoint.

Notably, Taapsee and Kangana's feud started in 2019. It intensified after Kangana's sister, Rangoli Chandel, called Taapsee a “sasti copy” of Kangana on social media. The exchange further escalated in 2020 after Kangana referred to Taapsee and others as “B-grade actresses” and “needy outsiders” amid debates around nepotism and industry politics.
As per the latest buzz, Taapsee, however, has maintained that despite their differences, she is ready to be friends with the star.

In further updates, Speaking on Shubhankar Mishra’s YouTube channel in an old interaction, Taapsee shared, “I don’t know if I ever fought. A fight happens when two people clash. I never clashed. You tell me — have I ever shared even a single line against her? Her sister called me a ‘cheap copy.’ She shared that since I don’t earn as much money as her, that makes me cheap. If she is such a brilliant star, I have no problem being called her copy. You can take out any statement of mine – I haven’t shared anything against her.”

On top of that, On the work front, Taapsee was last seen in Gandhari, an action thriller directed by Devashish Makhija. The movie follows a mother's relentless pursuit to find and rescue her kidnapped daughter, exploring themes of revenge and redemption amidst her harrowing journey.

title: Shaan buys Rs 48 crores Palmera home, highlights Mumbai’s luxury housing boom
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

The residence has been created by combining three separate apartments spread across approximately one-and-a-half floors on the 18th level of the tower. Shaan’s latest property acquisition also adds another chapter to his family’s long-standing association with Bandra. His late father, musician Manas Mukherjee, had also lived in the Mumbai suburb.

Adding to this, Located at 8 Turner Road, near the junction of St Martin’s Road, Palmera is a boutique residential project developed by Pantheion Real Estate. The tower stands on the redeveloped plot that once housed the bungalow of veteran star Mala Sinha. Rising 22 storeys above the ground, the development has only 32 residences, making it a low-density luxury address.

Meanwhile, Palmera offers open-plan bare-shell apartments that can be customised according to the owners’ requirements. The residences feature private apartment lobbies, open decks and 3.3-metre floor-to-ceiling heights. Individual homes start at around 2,090 square feet of carpet area, while full-floor residences extend beyond 4,180 square feet.

Notably, The development also offers several lifestyle and wellness facilities, including a rooftop infinity pool, sky deck, gymnasium, Pilates and yoga studios, meditation rooms, spa, salon vanity room, business meeting room, banquet hall, game room, library, card room and children’s play area. Other facilities include a pet zone, EV charging stations and valet services.

As per the latest buzz, Shaan’s Rs 48 crores purchase comes amid strong demand for premium homes in Mumbai. According to the Lighthouse Luxury Quarterly Real Estate Report, prepared with proptech intelligence platform Zapkey using verified Maharashtra government registration data, Mumbai recorded 1,499 luxury home registrations worth Rs 14,903 crore rupees during Q1 FY27, covering April to June 2026.

In further updates, The quarter saw nearly 16 luxury home transactions each day, with around Rs 164 crore rupees in transaction value generated daily. April recorded the highest number of registrations at 563, valued at Rs 5,726 crores. Although registrations fell by 22.7 per cent in May to 435 deals worth Rs 4,492 crores, the average ticket size remained at Rs 10.3 crore rupees.

On top of that, The market picked up again in June, which saw 501 registrations worth Rs 4,686 crore rupees. The recovery was largely driven by end-user demand for homes priced between Rs 5 crores and Rs 10 crores. Against this backdrop, Shaan’s high-value Palmera purchase reflects the continued appetite for premium residential properties in Mumbai.

title: Dia Mirza says ‘there was no disrespect’ as she defends son’s ‘schooling’ of delivery agent after backlash
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Dia Mirza faced backlash in June after she recounted an incident involving her five-year-old son, Avyaan Azaad Rekhi, who as per reports questioned an adult delivery worker for using a plastic bag. Now, the star has clarified that her son did not disrespect the coconut water vendor.

Adding to this, Dia Mirza Rekhi (Photo: Instagram) Dia Mirza defends her son amid backlash for ‘disrespecting’ coconut vendor In an interview with Zoom, Dia opened up that her son had simply voiced something that “people in their entire life are unable to”. She also defended him against trolls who called his behaviour privileged and elitist.

Meanwhile, She shared, “Now, if a child is learning to say, 'We do not use this' - of course, everybody made it about the nariyal wala, which it was not. Firstly, it was not during the peak of summer. So, those who are worried about the coconut vendor coming in the heat and supplying this coconut water to this household in a plastic bag was his livelihood. It was all about the optics that were created around the story, which were about how it was elitist and it was disrespectful to the coconut vendor. That was not the approach of the story, nor was it the reality.”

Notably, She further shared that her son never disrespected the delivery worker and added, “Everybody who knows me knows how I treat people. So, I don’t have to justify how I treat human beings. The child saw a coconut in a plastic bag. The child recognised that it was something we do not - if we don’t propagate it. The child had the agency and the awareness to say, 'Please yeh wapas le jao hamare ghar mein. It’s not allowed.' There is no disrespect here either.”

As per the latest buzz, During the podcast with Soha Ali Khan, Dia Mirza recalled how her son Avyaan refused to accept coconut water in a plastic bag and asked the delivery worker to take the plastic bag and straw back.
In further updates, Soha lauded Avyaan’s conviction, saying, “Imagine standing up to somebody who is an adult and to have that conviction.”

On top of that, The incident sparked criticism online, with some social media users accusing Dia of raising her son with a sense of entitlement and calling the interaction with the delivery worker privileged and elitist.

Dia was last seen in the show Operation Safed Sagar. The series, which also stars Jimmy Shergill, Siddharth, Abhay Verma, Prajakta Kohli and Mihir Ahuja, received critical appreciation. It is available to watch on nNetflix

title: Exclusive| Saif Ali Khan: Priyadarshan reminds me of my dad
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Saif Ali Khan is all excited for his next, directed by Priyadarshan and co-starring Akshay Kumar, Haiwaan, where he plays a visually impaired musician and martial arts coach. The star says interestingly both his director and his father the legendary Tiger Pataudi, are both cricketers who lost one eye but it did not deter them from making their mark in their respective fields.

Adding to this, Saif Ali Khan Saif says, "Priyadarshan is like Clint Eastwood, senior and calm. He reminds me of my dad. Both cricketers and both lost an eye but great in their professional space. Priyadarshan gives you just one take so you have to make quick decisions as an star and he wraps up shoot in time every single day."

Meanwhile, This is also his seventh movie with Akshay, ask him what makes them a great team and he says, " Akshay playing the villain elevated the project. It's the first time I'm playing a strong author backed role in a movie with him. He played my elder brother in our first movie together Yeh Dillagi and that set the tone for our relationship. We were new, weren't encroaching on each other and became good friends. I remember we had a 40 day shoot in Shimla and his Nepalese spot boy would sing Khiladi songs at 6am outside my room. I wanted to throw things at him because I just wanted to sleep." The star goes on to say that both Akshay and Priyadarshan believe Haiwaan is Saif's best work, “There is an interesting backstory to the character, his mother wanted him to learn music so he wouldn't get bored and his father made him learn martial arts because he would fall down a lot as a child.” He adds, “I too believe this is my best in a long time and cant wait for the audience to see it.”

Notably, While Saif isn't on social media, memes often refer to him as Gen Z before Gen Z was a thing. Be it clips of his old interviews or his humourous acts. A clip where Netizens thought he is seeking his own blessings went widely shared. The star says with a laugh, "It was a huge poster of myself so I was just wishing the movie and me good luck. I am childlike and a little mad. I've been in the profession for 35 years so I was a very different person at 21-22 years old, when I made statements that are going widely shared now."

As per the latest buzz, The star goes on to say he has been trying to be present in every moment and live life completely. Ask him if this realisation happened after the 2025 home invasion and stabbing incident and he says, "That could be true but it also comes with age." Back then there was buzz that he has hired high profile security, but the star continues to be his carefree self. Saif says, “I'm very lucky, that incident was quite close. The truth is I don't even like to share the car with my spotboy, I like sitting alone. I'm from the 90s' where we would sit alone doing nothing in between shots. There are a lot of people on sets these days and sometimes you just need it to be quiet. Things get crowded very quickly in Mumbai.” He adds, "I've never liked security but sometimes its necessary."

In further updates, The star just turned a year older on August 16. Speaking about the celebrations he says he rang in the special occasion in England. Saif recalls, "We celebrated at a close friend's house, where we cooked an Indian meal and had a glass of wine. The kids were playing around and it was a lovely time."

On top of that, Speaking of kids the internet can't get enough of Taimur, the mini Saif- the elder quieter one and Jeh, mini Kareena - the excited, expressive one. The star says, "All the four kids have very different personalities. Ofcourse Sara and Ibrahim are older and then there are these two. Tamiur seems quiet but not necessarily is that. I'm aware the internet is full of jokes about Jeh, the firecracker younger brother. We are just very blessed to have all this."

title: Priyanka Chopra says she wouldn't have loved Nick Jonas if he didn't respect her culture: ‘Really important’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Priyanka Chopra and Nick Jonas have been an inspiration for interracial and intercultural couples around the world. The two often speak about how they have found their biggest cheerleader in each other and how both have accepted and respected each other's cultures.

Adding to this, Priyanka Chopra on relationship with Nick Jonas. (Instagram/ EatTweetBlog) ‘Don't know if I'd love him’ In a recent interaction with E! News, Priyanka spoke about how important it was for her for Nick to accept her culture for the future of their relationship and shared that if Nick wasn't respectful towards her culture, they might not have gotten together. When asked about Nick's respect for her Indian culture and traditions, Priyanka shared, "I don't know if I'd love him if he didn't. That is a big part of any story or any relationship that is multicultural. I think it's really important to have a sense of respect for your partner's roots."
Meanwhile, The star also lauded Nick for helping to maintain the spark in their romance. She shared, "Being kind to your partner. That's something that's really important."

Notably, Priyanka was present at the premiere of the documentary Cycle of Love in New York. She served as an executive producer on the documentary, which tells the real-life love story of K. Mahanandia and Lotta Von Schedvin, who travelled across countries decades ago to be together.

As per the latest buzz, Of late, Priyanka Chopra penned a long, emotional note as Nick Jonas rolled out his new album Sunday Best. In her note, Priyanka called being with Nick the best decision she ever made.

In further updates, "There aren’t enough words to express myself, but I’ll try. You are what dreams are made of…Find yourself someone who not only loves and respects you but cherishes you like a treasure and isn’t afraid to show it. I’m so grateful that the universe led me to you. You’re the best decision I ever made," she wrote.

On top of that, The star also lauded Nick's talent. She wrote: "I’m so in awe of your endless talent. You’re the most honest and sincere person I’ve ever known.. and the most beautiful part of it is.. It’s just who you are. You don’t even try. You are the reason I smile every day. Thank you for being mine. These pictures are from our early days, but they still feel like yesterday."

Calling Nick " a secure person", Priyanka wrote, "I’m so proud of this album. You bared your soul in every note and every lyric. It takes a really secure person to be able to reach down so deep and share it with the world. I love you endlessly. Do yourself a favour. Grab the one you love and listen from the beginning. This is how love should be. #SundayBest out now."

title: Shaan and wife Radhika make real estate move in Mumbai's Bandra, invest in three luxury flats worth ₹48 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Shantanu Mukherji, popularly known as Bollywood singer Shaan, and his wife, Radhika Mukherji, have purchased three flats in Bandra West, Mumbai, from developer NVK Realty LLP for a total consideration of ₹ 47.64 crore rupees, according to property registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix.

Adding to this, Shantanu Mukherji, popularly known as Bollywood singer Shaan, and his wife, Radhika Mukherji, have purchased three flats in Bandra West, Mumbai, for a total consideration of ₹47.64 crore rupees (Photo: Instagram) The apartments are located on higher floors of the Palmera project on Turner Road in Bandra West and have a combined area of 6,267.87 sq ft . Each unit was purchased for ₹ 15.88 crore rupees, the documents showed .
Meanwhile, The transaction attracted a total stamp duty of ₹ 2.70 crore rupees and was registered on August 20, 2026 . The purchase also includes nine car parking spaces .
Notably, The new residence has been created by joining three separate apartments and was officially registered on August 20, the documents showed.

As per the latest buzz, The developer’s website states that the luxury condominium on Turner Road in Bandra West has significant Bollywood history, as it was formerly the home of veteran movie star Mala Sinha.

In further updates, The ₹ 48-crore rupees purchase comes amid a strong luxury housing market in Mumbai. The city recorded 1,499 luxury property registrations worth ₹ 14,903 crore rupees between April and June, according to the Lighthouse Luxury Quarterly Luxury Real Estate Report cited by Mumbai Mirror.

On top of that, Last year, Shaan, along with his wife Radhika , had purchased a luxury bungalow in Prabhachiwadi, Pune, for ₹ 10 crore rupees, according to property registration documents reviewed by Square Yards.

The couple had purchased a luxurious plot-plus-bungalow property. The plot spans approximately 0.4 hectares (~4,787.92 sq. yd), while the built-up area is around 5,500 sq. ft. (~511.04 sq. m). The transaction incurred a stamp duty of Rs. 50 lakh and a registration fee of Rs. 30,000.

title: Rajkumar Santoshi says Batwara 1947 differs from Dhurandhar: ‘Sunny Deol has played action heroes with dignity’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Right after Sunny Deol -starrer Batwara 1947 rolled out in theatres, comparisons between the movie and Ranveer Singh's juggernaut Dhurandhar ensued. Now, in a recent interaction, director Rajkumar Santoshi spoke about the depiction of masculinity in films and how violence is often being used merely as proof of masculinity. In this regard, he also explained how Sunny Deol's character in Batwara 1947 is different.

Adding to this, Rajkumar Santoshi opened up on Batwara 1947 being compared with Dhurandhar. ‘People are using bad words, drinking; it's so cheap’ In conversation with India Today, Rajkumar called Aditya Dhar “a very fine director”, pointing out the success of Uri: The Surgical Strike and how he has a different style. He also lauded Ranveer Singh's performance in Dhurandhar, saying he had “fantastically performed”.

Meanwhile, The director shared that he isn't against muscular action in films, but feels that violence is being used merely as proof of masculinity in films. He shared, "Today people are using bad words, abusing, drinking; it's so cheap. Sunny has played action heroes with dignity. He has played the role of a true macho guy. Those are powerful and memorable performances. We (Sunny and I) will do more action films, but with standards and class. Not to show off strength, but with good reasoning. There should be a good purpose to fight and hit a man."
Notably, Speaking about Dhurandhar, Santoshi admitted that a hero who has endured such torment and torture may react as Ranveer Singh's character did.

As per the latest buzz, However, the director explained that Sunny Deol's role as Sikandar Mirza differed from Ranveer Singh's Hamza, because physical strength was only one aspect of the character. The director shared he was more interested in showing the choices the lead character makes amid turmoil. "He is the most courageous character I have written. One can fight with a single army, or a group of people, but to fight and take a stand against fanaticism in today’s time, impossible. Nobody will dare to do that,” the filmmaker concluded.
In further updates, Sunny Deol and director Rajkumar Santoshi reunited for the movie Batwara 1947 after 30 years, following their last collaboration on the 1996 action movie Ghatak.

On top of that, Batwara 1947 received an underwhelming response at the ticket-window. Its total domestic collections stand at ₹ 34.47 crore rupees net after a week. The movie has also received mixed reviews from critics and audiences.

title: Kareena Kapoor, Dhanush to star in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's next? Director PS Mithran gives update
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Speculations about Kareena Kapoor Khan working in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's next movie have been doing the rounds for some time. Now, director S Mithran has shared an update on the same. It was previously reported that Dhanush and Kareena are in advanced talks for a Hindi movie, which will be produced by Sanjay Leela Bhansali and directed by PS Mithran.

Adding to this, Kareena Kapoor, Dhanush to star in a movie together. Kareena, Dhanush to star in Bhansali's movie? S Mithran, who is currently busy with the promotions of his latest movie Sardar 2, spoke about the soon-to-release project with Kareena and Dhanush and told Cinema Vikatan, “Talks are underway, we are looking at the dates for confirmation. Hopefully, something good will come out of it."

Meanwhile, As per reports, this will be a large-scale mythological jungle adventure. According to a report in Bollywood Hungama, the movie is currently in the writing stage and the script has undergone multiple rewrites before being finalised. It is also expected that the movie's pre-production will begin in November 2026, with principal photography planned for January 2027.

Notably, If this project works out, it will mark a lot of firsts for the movie's cast and crew. It will be Mithran's directorial debut in Hindi cinema, as well as the first onscreen pairing of Dhanush and Kareena Kapoor Khan. It will also mark Kareena's first collaboration with Sanjay Leela Bhansali after their fallout in the early 2000s.

As per the latest buzz, In the 2000s, Bhansali had approached Kareena for Devdas, and she also did a screen test for the same. However, he instead went ahead with Aishwarya Rai Bachchan to play the character of Paro. In a chat with Filmfare in 2002, Kareena shared, “What he did to me was wrong. He screen-tested me for Devdas, gave me a signing amount, then took someone else. That was wrong, it hurt especially because I was at the start of my career.”

In further updates, Bhansali, on the other hand, had claimed that it was not him but Kareena who had approached him for the role. He did the screen test, but it was not a mark of certainty that she would be cast in the movie.

On top of that, “After going through the photographs, I told Kareena that I felt Aishwarya Rai was fabulous and perfect for Paro; she has the aristocratic looks I required. Kareena didn’t say a word then but some days later I found her lashing out at me in print. She accused me of backing out after having given her the signing amount and contract. Believe me, this is not true,” he had shared.
Kareena will next be seen in Daayra. The movie is directed by Meghna Gulzar and co-stars Prithviraj Sukumaran. The movie is scheduled for rollout on September 18.

title: 7 Dogs review: Salman Khan, Sanjay Dutt compete for 'Most Pointless Cameo' in unexciting Hollywood-ish action drama
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Get Smart (2008), starring Steve Carell, was quite a funny movie. A spoof of the James Bond movies, it followed a bumbling spy who somehow had to save the day. I bring it up while reviewing 7 Dogs because this movie feels like it was torn from the same playbook. The crucial difference? Get Smart knew it was a joke. 7 Dogs seems blissfully unaware and is not even as funny.

Adding to this, 7 Dogs features an international cast with cameos by Sanjay Dutt, Salman Khan, and Giancarlo Esposito. What is 7 Dogs about? The only thing 7 Dogs' directors, Adil El Arbi and Bilall Fallah, manage to replicate consistently is the Hollywood feel of films built around time-bound missions. This story follows a cop and a convict who are forced to team up to find out exactly what the ‘Pink Lady’ is and, in the process, uncover the identities of the seven Dogs, a group of international criminals.
Meanwhile, The movie takes the duo across the world, in a setup that occasionally feels like a less exciting version of Mission: Impossible- Ghost Protocol.

Notably, One of their stops is India, where they encounter Salman Khan and Sanjay Dutt . This is, perhaps, the most underwhelming either star has looked on screen in a long time. For starters, there are distracting audio issues in their scenes, with their dialogue often sounding poorly integrated into the movie.

As per the latest buzz, The problem is that neither appearance carries any real sense of excitement or menace. They are on screen for barely five minutes each, and both performances seem to conflate animation with the swagger of a Hollywood action movie. Instead of making the India portions feel like a big international detour, their cameos end up looking like obligatory star appearances that the movie has no idea how to use.

In further updates, Oh, and then there is India. Even for a movie made in Riyadh, the visual shorthand remains the same: dingy, overcrowded streets and hungry children. It is a tired way of depicting the country, and one wishes filmmakers would simply move on from this overused template.

On top of that, The screenplay is also weighed down by forced humour, with jokes routinely inserted. The first half, in particular, is painfully predictable, offering little in the way of twists or turns. Robrecht Heyvaert’s camerawork, thankfully, brings some visual flair to the proceedings, with a few inventive shots. The action set pieces, however, are lazy, relying on familiar staging rather than finding ways to make the missions feel either fresh or thrilling.
Monica Bellucci, in a special appearance, gives us one of her laziest performances so far.

title: Arjun Rampal marries longtime girlfriend Gabriella Demetriades in Goa
body: Here's the latest relationship update doing the rounds:

According to PTI, Arjun and Gabriella completed the required marriage formalities at the office. The couple had earlier secured special permission from the Assistant Public Prosecutor of the local court to waive the mandatory 15-day waiting period between the first and second signatures required under Goa’s marriage laws.

Adding to this, Sub-Registrar Suraj Vernekar verified that the marriage was registered under Goa’s Uniform Civil Code. Arjun and Gabriella as per reports reached the office at around 4 pm and kept their appearance casual for the occasion.

Meanwhile, The couple’s relationship began in 2018, following Arjun’s separation from his former wife, Mehr Jesia. They welcomed their first child, son Arik, in 2019, before making their relationship official through marriage. Four years later, they became parents to their second son, Ariv. In 2025, Arjun revealed his engagement to Gabriella, six years after the two started dating.

Notably, Before their marriage, Arjun had spoken about his decision to stay unmarried despite sharing two children with Gabriella. During an appearance on Ranveer Allahbadia’s YouTube channel, the star explained his perspective on marriage and the legal bond it creates.

As per the latest buzz, Arjun shared, “It’s not me, it’s not her. What is marriage? A piece of paper after all. I think we are already married and there is no doubt in my mind about that. But, sometimes what that piece of paper can also do is change you. Because it’s like you think it’s permanent, it’s a false notion in fact but you are just legally bound.”

In further updates, He further explained, “It could change your attitude towards each other. I think that’s how we both feel. Whatever has happened between us was very organic. I don’t want to speak much about it because I don’t want to jinx it. I don’t think I need to justify this to anybody. For us, this is beautiful. You should keep experiencing it for as long as you can. In both our minds, we are married to each other. We are both pushing each other in the right direction and at the same time, we are boyfriend-girlfriend.”

On top of that, Arjun had also clarified that his views did not mean he was against marriage. The couple has now formally registered their relationship, marking a new chapter in their journey together.

title: Deepika Padukone met Sandeep Reddy Vanga 'only once', didn't even get narration: 'Would never work with him' | Exclusive
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

It was in April 2025 that Deepika Padukone decided not to be a part of Sandeep Reddy Vanga ’s Spirit. It is August 2026, and somehow, we are still talking about it. The star’s exit from the pan-India movie caused a huge uproar, with the filmmaker hurling allegations on social media and the industry debating work hours for artistes. The row erupted once again this week when Pranay , the director’s brother, claimed one of the reasons for Deepika’s exit was her demand for a profit share. Now, Hindustan Times has learnt the other version of events for the first time, as a highly-placed source close to the developments has informed us why the star chose not to do the movie.

Adding to this, Deepika Padukone was in talks with Sandeep Reddy Vanga for his movie Spirit last year. ‘Deepika never commits to a movie without full narration’ Hindustan Times reached out to a source close to the developments, who shared, “Deepika Padukone has met Sandeep Reddy Vanga all of once in her life. Not to mention, the filmmaker arrived a whole hour late to the meeting! Deepika took the rest of the meeting professionally. In the meeting, only a one-liner of the movie was shared. She didn’t receive a full narration of the movie. Deepika never commits to a project without receiving a full narration. So, Spirit was never a part of Deepika’s consideration set to begin with.”

Meanwhile, The source added that Deepika has no inclination to work with the filmmaker: “Sandeep Reddy Vanga is the kind of filmmaker Deepika Padukone would never collaborate with, given his misogynist nature: one that is greatly evident not only in his off-screen persona but in his movies too.”

Notably, Deepika Padukone was in talks with Sandeep Reddy Vanga for his Prabhas-starrer Spirit last year. But in April, it emerged that the star had exited the project. The star as per reports asked for a fixed 8-hour workday as a new mother, a demand that was not met by the movie’s production. The makers of Kalki 2898 AD also revealed her exit from the sequel through a post on X, sparking online debate about professionalism, work-hour limits, and remuneration in high-budget projects.

As per the latest buzz, After reports emerged that Triptii Dimri would be replacing Deepika, it was claimed that Deepika left the movie because she was uncomfortable with certain intimate scenes. At this point, director Sandeep Reddy Vanga shared an angry message on Twitter seemingly directed at Deepika. “When I narrate a story to an star, I place 100% faith. There is an unsaid NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement) between us. But by doing this, you've 'DISCLOSED' the person that you are.... Putting down a Younger star and ousting my story? Is this what your feminism stands for?” he wrote in May 2025.
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Sandeep Reddy Vanga (@sandeepreddy.vanga)

On top of that, The row erupted again this past week after Pranay, Sandeep’s brother, claimed that one of the reasons for Deepika’s exit was her demand for 10% profit share in the movie. Speaking with NTV Telugu, Pranay Reddy Vanga added, “The reason is the same as what was already mentioned. One was remuneration, the second was timing. Apart from that, there are some other reasons, too. Soon after, everything went overboard. See, she can ask for anything. If we are willing to give, we can give. But the economics should also work out for us. We thought that it was not working. This is why we thought of other options. Once we started looking for other options, they started leaking everything.”
On Friday, Deepika liked a post on Instagram that called out Sandeep and Pranay for their stance, which lauded the star for asking for ‘what men routinely get’ in the industry.

title: Over 50 detained, crowd at Jantar Mantar despite no nod: What happened at ‘Reservation Hatao Andolan’
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

More than 50 people protesting against the caste-based reservation policy were detained at Jantar Mantar in Delhi on Friday as they gathered under the banner of Reservation Hatao Andolan (RHA). The detention followed a stand-off with security personnel in the afternoon, officers aware of the matter shared.

Adding to this, A crowd gathered during the “Reservation Reform Satyagraha” demonstration called by the Reservation Reform Alliance (RRA) against caste-based reservation at Jantar Mantar, in New Delhi on Friday. (ANI) The protesters had gathered at Jantar Mantar despite the police's repeated reminder that no permission had been granted to stage a demonstration there. In the morning, hundreds of protesters, mobilised by different organisations representing people from general castes to seek reforms in reservations and quotas, arrived at Jantar Mantar.
Meanwhile, Some protesters alleged that internet jammers had been deployed around the site, making it difficult to access social media from the area. The claim could not be independently verified.

Notably, In a letter, deputy commissioner of police (central) Rohit Rajbir Singh shared, "...for peaceful protest of maximum of 500 persons at Ramlila Ground for Reservation Hatao Andolan has been considered in this office and we have no objection..."
As per the latest buzz, However, the protesters, refused to leave Jantar Mantar and had a stand-off with the security personnel guarding the Jantar Mantar protest site.

In further updates, The protest drive was led by an Instagram page 'Reservation Hatao Andolan', which later called on its followers to participate in an in-person demonstration at Jantar Mantar on August 21. The page has amassed 5.6 million followers on the platform.

On top of that, The Reservation Hatao Andolan protesters shared the government should consider the economic condition of the candidates rather than caste alone. "A poor person, irrespective of caste, should be provided assistance for education, coaching and other needs," news agency PTI quoted a protester associated with the Akhil Bharatiya Kshatriya Mahasabha as saying.

Another protester demanded that the existing reservation system should be reassessed to ensure benefits reach the most disadvantaged. "Our contention is that the government should examine whether the present system is achieving its intended purpose and whether benefits are reaching people at the grassroots level," he shared.

title: ‘Assist the poor, irrespective of caste’: 5 demands at Reservation Hatao Andolan in Delhi
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
Several protesters were detained by Delhi Police on Friday as a large crowd gathered at Jantar Mantar for a demonstration against caste-based reservation.

Adding to this, Reservation Reform Alliance (RRA) members stage “Reservation Reform Satyagraha” demonstration against caste-based reservation at Jantar Mantar, in New Delhi on Friday. (ANI) The demonstration was mobilised largely through social media by the " Reservation Hatao Andolan ", an Instagram-based campaign that had appealed to its followers to join the physical protest. The page has around 5.6 million followers on Instagram.

Meanwhile, One of the recurring demands raised at the protest site was that economic disadvantage, rather than caste alone, should determine access to government support and benefits. Protesters also sought a review of the reservation framework, changes to quota policies and greater support for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS).

Notably, Protesters argued that financial circumstances should be considered while deciding who needs government assistance, including support for education, coaching, scholarships and other expenses.

As per the latest buzz, "Our demand is that economic condition should be considered while deciding who needs government support. A poor person, irrespective of caste, should be provided assistance for education, coaching and other needs," a protester associated with the Akhil Bharatiya Kshatriya Mahasabha shared, reported news agency PTI.

In further updates, Another participant shared, “We are not saying that economically weaker people should be left without support. We are saying that assistance should be targeted at those who need it, including through scholarships, fee support and coaching,” another protester told PTI.
On top of that, The protesters called for a broader review of the reservation system, arguing that its benefits may not always reach the most disadvantaged groups within reserved categories.

"We have been raising this issue for several years. Our contention is that the government should examine whether the present system is achieving its intended purpose and whether benefits are reaching people at the grassroots level," PTI quoted a protester as saying.

title: Govinda’s manager denies actor plans to marry Komal Rani Swarnkar, shades Sunita Ahuja: ‘Must be something in her mind’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The ongoing marital tension between Govinda and Sunita Ahuja has taken another turn after Sunita claimed that she withdrew her divorce petition because of the star’s alleged plans to marry star Komal Rani Swarnkar . Govinda’s manager, Shashi Sinha, has now dismissed the claim, insisting that there is no question of a second marriage and expressing hope that the couple can resolve their differences.

Adding to this, Sunita Ahuja claims Govinda is planning second marriage with Komal Rani Swarnkar. Govinda's manager dismisses Sunita Ahuja's claims In an interview with India Today, Govinda’s manager expressed shock over Sunita’s claims and shared, “I am hearing this from you. Aisa kuch nahi hai aur nahi hoga. Koi doosri shaadi nahi ho rahi (There's nothing like this, nor will it happen. There's no second marriage happening). She is his wife, and there must be something going on in her mind that she made those claims.”

Meanwhile, He added that if Govinda were really planning a second marriage, he would have been the one to file for divorce rather than Sunita. He shared, “They are both mature people, and while Govinda has never spoken a word against Sunita in public, she has been the one washing dirty linen out. I am sure they both want the best for themselves and their children. We don't know what came over her that she took the decision back, but we can hope that things iron out. It's also for the betterment of the kids, for they really get affected by all this negativity.”

Notably, During a phone conversation with Rakhi Sawant, Sunita claimed she decided to withdraw her divorce case because Govinda and Komal were allegedly planning to get married. “Maine kal divorce case wapas le liya kyunki woh shaadi karne ke plan me the woh log (I withdrew the divorce case yesterday because they were planning to get married),” Sunita shared, explaining why she withdrew the petition.

As per the latest buzz, It all started when Govinda and Komal were spotted together at the airport. Following their appearance together, Sunita made strong comments about the star. In conversation with paparazzi, she called Govinda “Komal's sugar daddy” while questioning their equation. Later, Govinda warned Sunita against defaming him and asked her to “stay in limits” while in conversation with the paparazzi. He also claimed that Sunita was backed by a Bollywood gang trying to bring him down.

In further updates, Govinda and Sunita got married in 1987. In 2024, Sunita filed for divorce, and the petition as per reports cited adultery, cruelty and desertion under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act. After Govinda’s recent remarks, Sunita was seen exiting Mumbai’s Bandra Family Court on August 19, accompanied by her son Yashvardhan.

On top of that, Govinda’s manager, Shashi Sinha, later verified that she had withdrawn the divorce petition she had filed around two years ago. “It has been going on for two years, but it's finally over now. title: Deepika Padukone 'likes' post throwing shade at Sandeep Reddy Vanga in Spirit row: 'Misogyny couldn't handle woman's no'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

It has been over a year since Deepika Padukone walked out of Sandeep Reddy Vanga ’s Spirit, but the row around it refuses to die down. Deepika’s exit and the reported reasons around it had generated significant buzz at the time, and the issue came into the limelight this week once again after director Vanga’s brother claimed the real reason for Deepika’s exit was the production’s refusal to heed her 10% profit share demand. Following this, a social media post called out the two Vanga brothers for their statements, and it drew support from Deepika herself.

Adding to this, Deepika Padukone showed her support to an Instagram post shading Sandeep Reddy Vanga. Deepika likes post calling out Sandeep Reddy Vanga On Friday, journalist Janvi Manchanda shared a long note in the form of a carousel post on Instagram. Referring to Pranay Vanga’s recent statement, the post was captioned, “Sandeep Reddy Vanga’s brother Pranay claims Deepika Padukone asked for 10% profit share of Spirit and I’m just wondering, did we forget male actors have been doing this for years? Why is a woman doing the same NEWS?” In the post, Janvi called out the double standard of admonishing a woman for just asking for what has become the norm for men in the industry. The first slide read: “Breaking: Deepika Padukone Allegedly Wanted 10% Of Spirit's Profits. Judging by the meltdown, you'd think she asked for the entire movie and Vanga estate. Sounds like we have a full-blown male-ego crisis on our hands. A woman rejected a deal, and misogyny couldn't handle a woman's "no."”

Meanwhile, Deepika Padukone showed her support for the post by liking it. By Saturday morning, the post had over 8k likes in 12 hours, along with close to 2K reposts and shares, showing support from a lot of Deepika followers.

Notably, Deepika had left Spirit last year, with reports claiming she could not come to terms with the production’s demands, and had insisted on an 8-hour workday for her as a new mother. But in a recent interview with NTV Telugu, Pranay Reddy Vanga shared the exit was due to Deepika asking for 10% share in the movie’s profits. “The reason is the same as what was already mentioned. One was remuneration, the second was timing. Apart from that, there are some other reasons too. Soon after, everything went overboard. See, she can ask for anything. If we are willing to give, we can give. But the economics [budget] should also work out for us. We thought that it was not working. This is why we thought of other options. Once we started looking for other options, they started leaking everything,” Pranay shared.

As per the latest buzz, Deepika Padukone had been slated to start filming Sandeep Reddy Vanga’s Prabhas -starrer Spirit last year. But in April, it emerged that the star had exited the project. The star asked for a fixed 8-hour workday as a new mother, a demand that was not met by the movie’s production. The makers of Kalki 2898 AD also revealed her exit from the sequel through a post on X, sparking online debate about professionalism, work-hour limits, and remuneration in high-budget projects. After stories about Triptii Dimri replacing Deepika leaked, some reports claimed Deepika left the movie as she was uncomfortable with certain intimate scenes. Director Sandeep fumed on Twitter: “When I narrate a story to an star, I place 100% faith. There is an unsaid NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement) between us. But by doing this, you've 'DISCLOSED' the person that you are.... Putting down a Younger star and ousting my story? Is this what your feminism stands for?”
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Sandeep Reddy Vanga (@sandeepreddy.vanga)

On top of that, Triptii eventually did replace Deepika in the movie. The first look featuring her and Prabhas was launched on New Year’s Day 2026. The movie also stars Vivek Oberoi in the lead role, and is slated to rollout on March 5, 2027.
Deepika, meanwhile, has two big films lined up. She will be seen next in King with Shah Rukh Khan. Deepika is also slated to star alongside Atlee’s Raaka, opposite Allu Arjun.

title: Quota within quota, more EWS benefits: YouTuber Ajeet Bharti's key demands at 'Reservation Hatao' protest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

YouTuber Ajeet Bharti, speaking at a protest against caste-based reservation at Jantar Mantar in Delhi, called for a review of the existing reservation system and outlined four key demands, including a white paper on reservations, quota within quota, minimum marks for admissions and greater benefits for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS).

Adding to this, Bharti shared the first demand was for the government to publish a white paper detailing the reservation system and its impact over the past 80 years. (X@ANI) The protest was organised by ‘Reservation Hatao Andolan’, a social media movement opposing quotas. A large number of people gathered at Jantar Mantar on Friday despite police permission being granted for the demonstration at Ramlila Maidan.

Meanwhile, In a conversation with news agency ANI , YouTuber Bharti shared the first demand was for the government to publish a white paper detailing the reservation system and its impact over the past 80 years.

Notably, “Our biggest demand is that the government should come up with a white paper stating that the reservations you've given to people for 80 years... I come from Bihar. Research how dire the situation of the Musahar community is. Their children aren't getting reservations. Why? Because those caste groups don't even have leaders, he told news agency ANI”

As per the latest buzz, He shared the Musahar community in Bihar was an example of groups that, according to him, were not receiving the benefits of reservations because they lacked political representation.
In further updates, Bharti's second demand was for a quota within the existing quota system. He also questioned the government's position on the creamy layer in such a system.

On top of that, “The second demand is quota within quota, on which the government has also shared that we will not implement the creamy layer in it. Why will you not implement it? It is so absurd that the government is bowing down to those few Dalit leaders who only talk about their caste group...”

Earlier, this month, the government told the Supreme Court of India that the concept of a "creamy layer" cannot be extended for the reservation of the Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribes categories. The government argued that the doctrine has consistently been applied to Other Backward Classes (OBCs) only.

title: Protests, agitations alone cannot solve issues like graft: RSS
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Hyderabad The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) on Friday shared protests and agitations alone cannot provide solutions to corruption and other systemic shortcomings; and it requires positive and constructive approach from the government as well as the society in resolving the public grievances.

Adding to this, HT Image Addressing a press conference at the conclusion of the RSS’s three-day All India Coordination Meeting near Visakhapatnam in Andhra Pradesh, RSS Sah Sarkaryavah C R Mukunda shared wherever there were shortcomings in the system, awareness in society, along with efforts by the government, was necessary to correct them.

Meanwhile, Responding to a question on the recent agitation at Jantar Mantar and allegations of corruption and shortcomings in various government systems, the RSS joint general secretary shared the organisation did not view such issues merely through the prism of corruption.

Notably, Mukunda cited issues such as the NEET examination and other systemic problems as examples of concerns that could create anxiety among young people about their future. He shared these concerns needed to be understood and addressed rather than being allowed to escalate into wider social discontent.

As per the latest buzz, “Solutions will not emerge merely through protest or disruption,” Mukunda shared, emphasising the need for the Centre, state governments and society to jointly work towards improving systems.

In further updates, The RSS and 32 Sangh-inspired organisations concluded their three-day coordination meeting, during which they discussed a range of issues concerning society, including demographic changes, drug abuse among youth, the aspirations of the younger generation, environmental conservation, family values and the impact of artificial intelligence.
On top of that, The meeting was attended by RSS Sarsanghchalak Dr Mohan Bhagwat, Sarkaryavah Dattatreya Hosabale and senior functionaries of the participating organisations.

Mukunda linked the issue of systemic shortcomings directly to the concerns of young people, saying that problems affecting education and other public institutions can have a wider impact on their confidence about the future.

title: Kerala HC allows conditional suspension of jail sentence of 4 convicts in 2003 Muthanga land agitation cases
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Thiruvananthapuram: The Kerala High Court on Friday allowed the conditional suspension of the five-yearjail sentence imposed on four convicts in the case of attempt to murder of police constable Abdul Salam and forest range officer PK Sasidharan in connection with the 2003 Muthanga land struggle in Wayanad.

Adding to this, HT Image The four accused -- M Geethanandan (72), Binu (54), Ramesan (53) and Anilkumar (48) -- were found guilty by the Kalpetta Sessions Court on July 31 in the case and imposed five years rigorous imprisonment and fines of ₹ 10,000 each for a range of offences including attempt to murder, wrongful restraint, wrongful assembly and rioting.
Meanwhile, The HC bench of Justice A Badharudeen, hearing petitions filed by the accused challenging their conviction by the sessions court, held that they have an ‘arguable case.’

Notably, The appellants’ counsel had pointed out that the sessions judge did not conclusively find commission of the offences and only prima facie found the offences. The standing counsel for the CBI, which investigated the cases with regard to the Muthanga land agitation, also submitted that they are filing an appeal to ‘address the flaws in the judgement.’

As per the latest buzz, “Going through the judgement and the period of sentence imposed, at par with the arguments advanced pointing out the innocence of the applicants, the appellants have an arguable case. Since it is submitted by the learning public prosecutor that the appellants have criminal antecedents, there is no reason to disallow the application and therefore, the petition to suspend the sentence is allowed on the following conditions,” the High Court ruled.

In further updates, The court directed the apellants to deposit the entire fine amount imposed by the sessions court, execute bail bond of ₹ 1 lakh each with two solvent sureties and not get involved in any other crimes. The accused must not be rolled out on bail until the fine amounts are realised, the court ordered.

On top of that, The cases pertain to the historic agitation for land spearheaded by the Adivasi Gothra Maha Sabha under the leadership of Geethanandan and CK Janu inside the Wayanad wildlife sanctuary in Muthanga in January 2003 in protest against then UDF government’s inaction on allotting land parcels to tribals.

Clashes broke out on the morning of February 19, 2003 when personnel from the police and forest departments began an operation to evict the protesters from the wildlife sanctuary in Muthanga. Pellets and tear gas shells were fired by the police in a bid to clear the area. The tensions escalated when constable Salam and forest officer Sasidharan were detained by the tribals, resulting in police firing. One tribal, Jogi, was killed in the firing, while police constable Vinod succumbed to fatal injuries sustained during the clashes.

title: Supreme Court junks petitions challenging The Kerala Story, but leaves legal questions about CBFC certification open
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Supreme Court on Friday closed the proceedings on a batch of petitions relating to the controversial 2023 movie, The Kerala Story , while leaving open the question of law relating to challenges to certification of films by the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC).

Adding to this, The Kerala Story rolled out on May 5, 2023. SC disposes of petitions against The Kerala Story Chief Justice of India Surya Kant-led bench on Friday disposed of dozens of cases which were filed either during the COVID-19 period or became infructuous due to the passage of time.

Meanwhile, Dealing with two pleas seeking cancellation of CBFC certification of The Kerala Story, the bench, which also comprised Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, shared that the petitions have become infructuous.

Notably, The third plea filed by the movie's producers, Sunshine Pictures Pvt Ltd and Vipul Amritlal Shah, was withdrawn. The petition had challenged the then West Bengal government's decision to ban the movie.

As per the latest buzz, The top court, in May 2023, stayed the ban imposed by the state government. Advocate Nizam Pasha, appearing for petitioners Qurban Ali and B R Aravindakshan in the other two matters, submitted that the issues raised by his clients continued to survive despite the movie having already been rolled out.

In further updates, Pasha pointed out that the Kerala High Court had disposed of a writ petition concerning the movie after observing that the plea was not maintainable against the grant of a certificate to a movie by the CBFC.

On top of that, He shared that while the statutory remedy against CBFC certification was available to the producer, other persons aggrieved by the contents of a movie had no such statutory remedy and were, therefore, required to approach the court through a writ petition. The bench, however, noted that the movie had already been rolled out.

Justice Bagchi observed that the question of law could be left open. "The litigation has to await another movie... another movie that is controversial, we will go into that question," Justice Bagchi shared.

title: Mini Mathur wants men to stop asking women about having kids: ‘Apni advice apne paas rakhiye’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mini Mathur talks about men commenting on the bodies of women. What Mini shared During the chat, Mini was asked what should men stop telling to women. In response, Mini shared, “Commenting on physicality. Are you feeling tired? Did you not get sleep? Did you put on weight? Oh you lost weight? What happened? From both sides, men and women… it is bad to comment like that. When did I give you permission to shorten this distance between you and me? That you are seeing my body and commenting about it?”

Adding to this, She went on to add, “Maintain some physical proximity. Asking women, what about kids? Have one more kid. It is great fun… Apni advice apne paas rakhiye (Keep your advice to yourself). When asked, only then respond. And stop calling people housewife, homemaker! That irritates me. I am a homemaker, and I work but I am a homemaker with great pride. So don't look at me and dare ask why am I not working? I am working on many things you don't even know!”

Meanwhile, Mini Mathur began her television career with Tol Mol Ke Bol with R Madhavan , before becoming an MTV VJ for many years. She became a household name with her stint in the singing reality show Indian Idol. She has since worked across television, streaming and films, including the series Mind the Malhotras. She also became a certified women's health coach specializing in menopause after completing a rigorous certification course.

Notably, She also revealed her own Instagram community Pauseitive, to guide women in their 40s and beyond for a smooth transition. The idea for the health advocacy platform began with her own experiences.

As per the latest buzz, "My own health journey started when I started feeling symptoms that didn't feel like the old me. I started getting hot flashes, I was sweating at night, I couldn't sleep very well, my joints ached, I had brain fog, I had a little bit of memory loss which you can understand for a television presenter can be very debilitating. Every doctor I went to treated my symptoms and not the root cause. I knew there was a deeper answer lying beneath and that's when I started asking questions," Mini says in a video posted to her Instagram page.

title: FIR for pellet injury during July 20 stir filed after Rahul Gandhi protests for over 6 hours
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Police on Friday lodged a first information report (FIR) against unknown people on a complaint by a Delhi University student with pellet injuries during the July 20 protests, after Congress leader Rahul Gandhi accompanied the 19-year-old and sat in protest outside a police station for more than six hours.

Adding to this, Lok Sabha LoP Rahul Gandhi and Sahil Lochav show the FIR copy after Delhi Police registered an FIR on Lochav's complaint as he had suffered pellet gun injuries during the July 20 protest. (@INCIndia/X) Gandhi’s dramatic stir outside the Parliament Street Police Station turned into a major political row with the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) attacking him for what it called “attention-seeking politics”.

Meanwhile, “Sahil’s FIR has been registered. This is the first step towards justice. But think about it - even permission to file an FIR had to come from the home ministry. Now it’s clear who has been holding the reins on justice,” Gandhi shared outside the station after the FIR was filed at 7pm.

Notably, Sahil Lochab, a Delhi University’s school of open learning student, shared that for the past eight days, he visited the Connaught Place, Sansad Marg and Mandir Marg police station and the crime branch office to register an FIR, but everyone rejected him. “I was then helped by Gandhi …I hoped that if he comes, my case will be heard. I’m the eldest son and these injuries have affected my future career goals and my studies.”
As per the latest buzz, By 12.30 pm, paramilitary forces were deployed and the gate of the station was closed to restrict the entry of more protesters.

In further updates, Sharma initially told HT that he received the complaint and the matter will be looked into. He also shared that all cases of violence and conspiracy during the Jantar Mantar stir were with the crime branch.
On top of that, By 12.30-1 pm, police barricaded Tolstoy Marg and Sansad Marg due to the swelling crowds.
Between 12.30pm and 6.30 pm, meetings took place between joint commissioner of police (New Delhi) Nupur Prasad, Sharma, Lochab and Gandhi.

title: Assam cab operators continue highway blockade over Shillong violence despite CMs’ talks
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Cab operators and transport workers continued to block the Assam-Meghalaya highway at Jorabat on Friday, protesting alleged attacks on Assam residents and vehicles during violence in Shillong, despite talks between the two states’ chief ministers to restore normalcy. Assam Police also opened helplines to assist stranded passengers and those facing difficulties travelling in Meghalaya.

Adding to this, The Assam-Meghalaya highway blockade continued over Shillong violence, with cab operators demanding assurances on the safety of Assam drivers and vehicles. (PTI) The violence was triggered during a “black-flag” motorcycle rally by the Khasi Students’ Union (KSU) on Wednesday, demanding recruitment reforms and implementation of security acts. Protesters vandalised and set ablaze vehicles, including those with Assam registration numbers, and damaged a glass panel of a statue of philosopher Swami Vivekananda.

Meanwhile, Assam cab operators prevented Meghalaya-registered vehicles from entering the state in protest against the violence that left many from their state injured and traumatised. They alleged that Assam-registered vehicles were targeted during the KSU rally. The Assam protesters shared they would not allow Meghalaya-registered cars to enter until action is taken over the attacks on their vehicles in Shillong. “The tourists first come to Guwahati, and then go to Meghalaya. We have faced harassment while taking passengers to Meghalaya. But what happened on Wednesday was a clear attack on people from Assam, and it has to be answered,” a protester shared.

title: All Indian Cine Workers Association backs Satendra Soni as he files FIR against filmmaker couple over assault
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Laapataa Ladies star Satendra Soni , who played a pivotal role in Aamir Khan's Laapataa Ladies, has filed an FIR against filmmaker Pushpendra Singh and his wife, star Pragati Chauhan, alleging non-payment of dues, assault, intimidation and wrongful confinement during the shoot of their movie Paid Paalki. The incident dates back to June, when the star has shared how the filmmaker allegedly refused to pay his fees and even threatened him when he asked for his payment.

Adding to this, Star Satendra Soni filed an FIR over brutal assault, forced confinement and other serious allegations on the filmmakers. AICWA extends full support On Friday, the All Indian Cine Workers Association backed the star on this case and posted an official statement on their X account. It read, “The All Indian Cine Workers Association (AICWA) has extended full support, assistance and guidance to Star Satendra Soni, known for Laapataa Ladies and several other films and associated with the soon-to-release Mirzapur, and Star Shreedhar Dubey, known for Oh My Dog and several other films, in connection with the serious incident involving brutal assault, forced confinement, death threats, intimidation and non-payment of dues during the shooting of the movie Paid Paalki in Maihar, Madhya Pradesh.”

Meanwhile, "AICWA President Suresh Shyamlal Gupta took up the matter from the very beginning, remained in continuous contact with both actors, approached the concerned authorities and personally supported them throughout the process, leading to the registration of an FIR at Oshiwara Police Station, Mumbai, on 20 August 2026, against Director/Producer Pushpendra Singh and Pragati Chauhan.

Notably, Star Satendra Soni has worked in Laapataa Ladies, which was India’s official entry for the 95th Academy Awards (Oscars), and has worked in several other films. He is also associated with the soon-to-release Mirzapur. AICWA considers it extremely serious that an established star could allegedly be subjected to such brutal treatment.

As per the latest buzz, AICWA raises a serious question: If such treatment can allegedly be inflicted on a known and established star, what happens to smaller actors, technicians and workers who may remain silent because of fear and pressure?

In further updates, If immediate and strict action is not taken in such cases, it may encourage further intimidation and exploitation of artists and movie workers. AICWA therefore demands a comprehensive investigation and strict legal action against anyone found responsible."

On top of that, The post further added how the case was taken up based on the allegations. "On 3 July 2026, AICWA President Suresh Shyamlal Gupta facilitated a meeting between Star Satendra Soni, Star Shreedhar Dubey and the Hon’ble Maharashtra State Home Minister Shri Yogesh Ramdas Kadam.

During the meeting, the actors informed the Hon’ble Minister about the incident, including the alleged assault on the road, being forcibly taken to the hotel, assault inside a closed room, tearing of their clothes and death threats.

title: Kangana Ranaut hits back at Sharmila Tagore over ‘Vande Mataram’ remarks: “How can you reduce such a great piece of art to mere religious practice”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The star-turned-politician argued that the song should be viewed as a work of art and a symbol of the freedom struggle.

Adding to this, Kangana Ranaut shared a video featuring Sharmila Tagore’s interview on Instagram and responded to the veteran star’s perspective. While acknowledging Tagore’s reservations, Kangana argued that the references in poetry and art should not necessarily be interpreted as literal religious practices.

Meanwhile, "I appreciate that Sharmila ji has spoken about her reservation on Vande Mataram, but I am shocked as an artist how can her views on art/poetry can be so limiting and contrived, in any poetry or song words are metaphors, a poet or artist uses all kinds of imaginations draws unbelievable parallels to bring about the desirable effect, Vande Matram is the spirit of freedom struggle Bankim Chandra ji is compelling the nation to awaken the Shakti within, how can you reduce such a great piece of art to mere religious practice," Ranaut wrote.

Notably, Kangana also referred to Swami Vivekananda’s famous emphasis on strength and used it to explain her interpretation of the word ‘Shakti’. She added, "Vivekananda famously shared I need youth who are made of iron, bones of steel and veins in which runs thunderbolt, he was not giving weather forecast, he was simply demanding Shakti to rise, please come out of Hindu Muslim mindset even if we believe in one God doctors also call power Shakti, let's embrace each other like our own, I absolutely love you and don't mind a crushing hug like you always give me."

As per the latest buzz, Meanwhile, recalling the statement Sharmila Tagore had made to ANI, the latter had shared, “My point of view is that there are many religious people who believe in one single God, not many Gods. In 'Vande Mataram' , there is a stanza which says that many Gods are mentioned in 'Vande Mataram'. ” She further shared, "It is difficult for those who believe in one religion to say, 'Vande Kali, Vande Durga'. Therefore, if we take all the religious people in India together, the first two stanzas are very good."

In further updates, The exchange comes amid discussions around ‘Vande Mataram’ , which was composed by Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay and became closely associated with India’s freedom movement. While Sharmila Tagore focused on the song’s religious references, Kangana highlighted its metaphorical and artistic dimensions, describing it as an invocation of strength and the spirit of resistance.

He shared the couple’s differences had played out in the media for nearly one-and-a-half to two years, causing unnecessary damage to their reputation. Ghar ki baatein ghar mein reh ke, baith ke baatein karke, bahut sab cheezein hoti hain. Aaj wapas lena tha, to kiya tha kyun? Ye baat ka mujhe dukh ho gaya. Kahe ko phir tamaasha hum log ban gaye? (There was no need for people to know about it. Matters concerning the family could have been discussed and resolved privately, within the home. If the intention was to withdraw the case today, then why was it filed in the first place? That is what saddens me. Why did we have to become a spectacle for everyone?)."

title: Auron Mein Kahan Dum Tha release funding row: Reliance Entertainment Studios enters insolvency process over Pen India’s Rs 11.94 crores claim
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:
NCLT Mumbai has admitted Reliance Entertainment Studios to CIRP over a Rs 11.94 crores default linked to Pen India’s funding for Auron Mein Kahan Dum Tha.

Adding to this, The tribunal has imposed a moratorium under Section 14 of the IBC and appointed Umesh Balaram Sonkar as the interim resolution professional. However, the NCLT clarified that it has not determined the final amount payable to Pen India and has left the process of collating the claim to the resolution professional.

Meanwhile, Pen India had advanced Rs 20 crores to Reliance Entertainment Studios under a security deposit agreement signed in November 2022. The agreement provided for repayment with interest at 21% per annum, compounded monthly. A subsequent agreement executed in October 2023 saw Friday Filmworks Private Limited, which is partly owned by Reliance, pay Rs 15 crores to Pen India.
Notably, According to Pen India, Rs 4.49 crores remained outstanding as principal, along with Rs 7.44 crores in interest.

As per the latest buzz, Reliance Entertainment Studios argued that the amount was expressly described as a security deposit and therefore did not constitute a money-lending arrangement. The company also contended that its liability had been extinguished under a contractual provision that required repayment through a third-party satellite or digital rights provider.

In further updates, The NCLT rejected these arguments, stating that the actual substance and commercial effect of a transaction matter more than the terminology used by the parties. “The transaction, therefore, possesses all the essential attributes of a borrowing notwithstanding the terminology adopted by the parties,” the tribunal shared.

On top of that, The bench also held that the clause concerning repayment through a third-party rights provider only created an additional mechanism for payment and did not remove Reliance’s primary liability.
The tribunal also took note of Reliance's subsequent conduct following the Rs 15 crores payment.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Sunny Deol and Rajkumar Santoshi set to reunite after Batwara 1947, exploring Ghatak sequel
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The soon-to-release project will mark their fifth collaboration, following Ghayal (1990), Damini (1993), Ghatak (1996), and the of late rolled out Batwara 1947 . While details are currently being kept under wraps, sources indicate that the project could be a sequel to the 1996 vigilante action movie Ghatak , widely regarded as one of Deol and Santoshi's most celebrated collaborations. Whether the movie retains the title Ghatak 2 or adopts a new name will depend on logistical considerations. However, the makers are developing it as a Ghatak sequel. The official announcement is expected within the next three months, with plans to take the movie into production by the middle of next year, subject to Deol's availability.

Adding to this, “Sunny Deol and Rajkumar Santoshi have shared a close friendship since Ghayal came out in 1990. Batwara 1947 not only brought them together professionally after nearly three decades but also rekindled their personal bond. They had a great rapport while working on the movie and have already discussed another project. In fact, the first narration has already been done, and Santoshi will soon resume work on the final draft,” a source close to the development told Bollywood Hungama .

Meanwhile, Deol has an exciting slate of films lined up. He will next be seen playing Lord Hanuman in Nitesh Tiwari's much-awaited Ramayana , which is set to rollout in theatres during Diwali 2026. He of late wrapped up shooting for Excel Entertainment's Antony , an action thriller co-starring Jyotika and Vijay Varma. He will soon return to the sets of Ramayana to shoot for the second chapter of the epic. Deol is also shared to be in talks with Mythri Movie Makers for Jaat 2 , although the project is still in the writing stage.

Notably, Meanwhile, Batwara 1947 has received appreciation from audiences for placing humanity above religious identity against the backdrop of Partition, one of the most traumatic and defining chapters in India's history. Although the movie has underperformed at the ticket-window, it has been viewed by some as a fresh voice at a time when films addressing communal divisions have become increasingly prominent.

title: SC disposes of petitions concerning The Kerala Story, leaves legal questions open
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Supreme Court on Friday closed the proceedings on a batch of petitions relating to the controversial 2023 movie, The Kerala Story , while leaving open the question of law relating to challenges to certification of films by the Central Board of Movie Certification ( CBFC ). Chief Justice of India Surya Kant-led bench on Friday disposed of dozens of cases which were filed either during the COVID-19 period or became infructuous due to passage of time.

Adding to this, The Kerala Story hit the theatres on May 5, 2023. What did the bench state? Dealing with two pleas seeking cancellation of CBFC certification of The Kerala Story, the bench, which also comprised Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, shared that the petitions have become infructuous. The third plea filed by the movie's producers, Sunshine Pictures Pvt Ltd and Vipul Amritlal Shah, was withdrawn. The petition had challenged the then West Bengal government's decision to ban the movie.

Meanwhile, The top court, in May 2023, had stayed the ban imposed by the state government. Advocate Nizam Pasha, appearing for petitioners Qurban Ali and B R Aravindakshan in the other two matters, submitted that the issues raised by his clients continued to survive despite the movie having already been rolled out. Pasha pointed out that the Kerala High Court had disposed of a writ petition concerning the movie after observing that the plea was not maintainable against the grant of a certificate to a movie by the CBFC.

Notably, He shared that while the statutory remedy against CBFC certification was available to the producer, other persons aggrieved by the contents of a movie had no such statutory remedy and were, therefore, required to approach the court through a writ petition. The bench, however, noted that the movie had already been rolled out. Justice Bagchi observed that the question of law could be left open. "The litigation has to await another movie... another movie that is controversial, we will go into that question," Justice Bagchi shared.

As per the latest buzz, Pasha submitted that the petitioners had specifically sought cancellation of the movie's certificate and pointed out that the movie continued to be available on OTT platforms. He also shared the petitioners had initially approached the Supreme Court against an interim order of the high court. But the high court subsequently disposed of the petition after noting that the Supreme Court was seized of the issue, he shared.

In further updates, Pasha further urged the court to lay down guidelines for films which allegedly promote hate speech. "Guidelines have to be laid down for films that promote hate speech," he shared. "Alright, file a comprehensive writ petition seeking general guidelines," the CJI responded.
On top of that, The bench subsequently recorded that the question of law would remain open and granted the parties liberty to initiate appropriate proceedings in accordance with law.

The Kerala Story, directed by Sudipto Sen and produced by Vipul Amrutlal Shah , had triggered a major political and social row following its rollout in 2023. The movie initially claimed that nearly 32,000 women from Kerala had been converted to Islam through deceit and forced to join the Islamic State (ISIS), a claim that drew strong criticism.

title: Taapsee Pannu starrer Gandhari to premiere on September 3
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Gandhari will premiere on Netflix on September 3, 2026.

Adding to this, Set in the fictional town of Joypurra, Gandhari centres on Bani, a mother whose search for her daughter takes her through a series of dangerous situations. The story explores themes of resilience, determination and a mother’s devotion while combining emotional drama with action.

Meanwhile, Taapsee Pannu plays the central role of Bani, in what is described as one of her more physically demanding performances. The movie also features Ishwak Singh, Chhaya Kadam, Swastika Mukherjee, Mita Vashisht and Jatin Sarna in key roles.

Notably, As Bani moves closer to finding her daughter, she encounters new threats and obstacles, with each situation adding to the tension surrounding her search. The movie brings together action sequences and the emotional aspects of Bani’s journey.

As per the latest buzz, Kanika Dhillon, Writer & Producer, shared, “With Gandhari, we wanted to tell the story of a woman who refuses to be defined by her circumstances. Bani's journey is raw, relentless and deeply personal, and that is what drew me to her from the very beginning. Reuniting with Taapsee once again has been incredibly special — there is a deep creative trust and understanding that we have built over the years, and watching her bring Bani to life with such commitment and intensity was truly rewarding. Collaborating with Devashish and an exceptional cast made this journey all the more fulfilling. Our partnership with Netflix has once again given us the opportunity to bring this story to life on the scale and canvas it deserves, and I’m incredibly excited for audiences to discover Gandhari on September 3.”

In further updates, Ruchikaa Kapoor Sheikh, Director, Original Films, Netflix India, shared, "Gandhari is a bold, emotionally charged action thriller that turns a mother’s love into a force- fierce, instinctive and impossible to ignore. We are delighted to reunite with Taapsee Pannu and Kanika Dhillon, building on a creative partnership we deeply value and carrying it into a strikingly different space with Devashish Makhija at the helm. It has been a rewarding year so far for us at Netflix, and with Gandhari we strive to continue to focus on telling rooted, authentic and entertaining stories.”
